purpose: Portable contract between an authorized social-data collector and Sarah or another host interface.
rules: Keep each person's signals and learned interests isolated by person_scope_id.
Do not collect when user_authorized is false.
Do not send social-media passwords, session cookies, recovery codes, or payment credentials through this contract.
Treat inferred interests as probabilistic and correctable, not facts about the person.
A single weak interaction should not normally become a durable interest.
Hosts may use a supported platform API, user-owned export, or other explicitly authorized provider behind this contract.
The UI is not part of this contract; Android, web, desktop, or another team interface may implement it independently.
